text: A nude human figure with light skin crouches low, holding a spear. Long blonde hair in a single braid falls over their shoulder. Face is angular, eyes focused forward. Wears brown leather belt with circular gold plates and matching arm cuffs. Kneeling on one knee, body angled toward viewer’s left. Behind them lies another figure prone on ground. Background shows dark water, reeds, and distant land under muted sky.
